pages.title: ORSA Instrument
pages.text: $(italic)ORSA stopped promising exact dates when the models started disagreeing with reality by the hour.$()$(br2)The $(item)Phase Barometer$() reads the current collapse state and estimates how close the next escalation is without turning the end of the world into a day counter.$(br2)Place one in a shelter, workroom, or command corner and treat it like damaged weather instrumentation doing its best.

pages.title: Forecast Bands
pages.text: $(bold)Stable$() means the current state is holding.$(br)$(bold)Deteriorating$() means conditions are sliding.$(br)$(bold)Transition Likely Soon$() means plan for the next escalation.$(br)$(bold)Imminent$() means stop pretending you have time.$(br)$(bold)Collapse Underway$() is reserved for the final atmospheric failure window.
A copper-and-glass diagnostic block that shows the current phase, the next expected escalation, and major late-game warnings like whiteout intensification, atmospheric thinning, and vacuum onset.

pages.title: Phase 6 Note
pages.text: Phase 6 is not one flat disaster.$(br2)$(bold)Early:$() extreme blizzard.$(br)$(bold)Mid:$() atmosphere thinning, wind drop-off, fog lift.$(br)$(bold)Late:$() vacuum onset.$(br2)The barometer keeps tracking those sub-stages so it stays useful after atmospheric collapse begins.
